title: Squeaky Boots
premise: A knight sneaks past a sleeping dragon. Every step squeaks like a rubber duck. One giant eye opens.
visual: Cave of gold coins. A huge sleeping dragon with one enormous eye wide open, looking down. A tiny knight frozen on tiptoe mid-step, cheeks puffed, one sweat drop, squeak lines under his boot.
characterLean: Tension gag for a quiet bar before a drop. The eye opening is the drop.
grokImaginePrompt: 2D hand-drawn cel animation frame in early-1990s Warner Bros. television cartoon style, NOT photoreal, NOT 3D, 4:3: a treasure cave piled with gold coins and goblets, a gigantic green dragon curled asleep with one enormous yellow eye wide open looking straight down, a tiny knight in shiny silver armor frozen on tiptoe mid-step on the coins, cheeks puffed out holding his breath, one big sweat drop, small curved squeak lines coming out from under his metal boot, a single coin balanced on his helmet, thick confident black ink outlines with slight taper, flat saturated cel color fills with one hard-edged shadow tone and no gradients on the characters, painted gouache background, faint cel dust, exaggerated squash-and-stretch, huge readable cartoon facial expressions, hand-drawn cartoon, Grok Imagine style
motion: 6-8s. Step: squeak. Freeze. Step: squeak. Freeze. Step: SQUEAK. The eye opens. Knight slowly looks up. Smiles. Waves.
notes: The squeak should sound exactly like a rubber duck. Cut before anything happens; the wave is the button.
